hooks.command: mkdir -p "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && src="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/statusline.sh" && dst="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/statusline.sh" && v() { sed -n "s/^# statusline-version: //p" "$1" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1; } && new="$(v "$src")" && old="$(v "$dst")" && { [ ! -f "$dst" ] || [ -z "$old" ] || [ "$(printf "%s\n%s\n" "$old" "$new" | sort -V | tail -n 1)" = "$new" ]; } && cp "$src" "$dst" && chmod +x "$dst" || true
